notes.title: Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines is releasing August 15th 🐶
notes.notes:
[h3]Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines, the highly anticipated sequel to the critically-acclaimed 2D action-platformer Grapple Dog, will launch on August 15th, 2024.[/h3]

In Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines, players will join Pablo and Luna, an intrepid duo of pups, as they swing, bounce, and blast their way through interdimensional landscapes on a mission to save the cosmos! Prepare for action-packed levels, challenging puzzles, and adorable canine capers in this vibrant and unforgettable adventure. Check out the Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines release date trailer below, featuring colourful, eye-catching animation from Jellybox Studios!

[h3]Watch the Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines Release Date Trailer here![/h3]
[previewyoutube=H8QtKTNatcA;full][/previewyoutube]

Featuring challenging platforming full of innovative twists and fresh abilities like fire-dashing and magnetic grabs, Grapple Dogs: Cosmic Canines allows players to propel themselves through a menagerie of breathtaking pixel-art landscapes with exhilarating speed and control. Every world is brimming with new and unique levels, hidden collectibles and secret areas to uncover, providing surprises across the galaxies. 

Players can sharpen their claws for two pawsome ways to play! For players who love to swing and sling? Beloved pupper Pablo returns with his trusty hook and acrobatic grappling skills ready to zip to new heights. More of a shoot-first pup? Players can unleash their inner gunslinger with mysterious newcomer Luna's arsenal of weaponry, adding a thrilling new combat mechanic to the mix. 

Time Trial modes offer players an added challenge, racing against the clock (and maybe otherworldly competitors!) to prove they're the ultimate top dog. Memorable boss battles introducing epic canine combatants bring players unforgettable showdowns for their interdimensional pups, as they swing, shoot, explore and wag their tails for the ultimate canine adventure!

notes.title: GRAPPLE DOGS: COSMIC CANINES COMING 2024 🐶
notes.notes:
[h2]PABLO IS BACK! 📣[/h2]
The pettable, adventurous, acrobatic pup Pablo returns, with his trusty grappling hook allowing him to zip across levels and worlds throughout the cosmos, completing tricky challenges and platforming tests, along with new powers and new friends. Every world is bursting with color, personality, vibrant characters, and unique mechanics to push your pawsome platforming powers to infinity and beyond!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39589458/9f5113a810979bc60474241e620c1742aa0aba1d.gif[/img]
[h2]WITH BRAND NEW FEATURES 🐶[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Pure platforming bliss[/b] - Fast-paced swinging action meets a whole host of fresh abilities, such as magnetic panels and fire-dashing, all coming together as a tight, fun platforming romp!

[*] [b]New worlds[/b] - Journey across dimensions in an epic quest to save... everything! Each unique world is bustling with vibrant, eye-catching pixel art and bubbling with personality!

[*] [b]Gameplay galore[/b] - Sail across the cosmos to explore multiple worlds filled with tons of levels. Hidden collectibles, secret areas, memorable boss battles, bonus levels, time trials, and more to sink those canines into - all in a cool 60 FPS.

[*] [b]Exhilarating soundtrack[/b] - Jazz Mickle's catchy, killer soundtrack will have Grapple Dogs' beats stuck in your head forever, with level-by-level jams that are sure to get that tail waggin'!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39589458/8cc91cb30f6b2695a1def8c8cf7cc2108171ff2c.gif[/img]

[h2]TWO DOGS ARE BETTER THAN ONE[/h2]
More action = more dogs! Mysterious newcomer Luna joins the adventure, with her weaponry adding exciting new gameplay features to the fray. Alternate between playing as the swingin' hero Pablo and the shoot-first-ask-questions-later anti-hero Luna as the two journey across worlds and dimensions, keeping your adventure fresh and engaging from start to finish. Whether you're swinging, butt-bouncing, or wall-climbing your way to victory, or aiming, blasting, and running, no two levels are quite the same.

notes.title: $3000 Speedrun Contest + Global Speedrun Authority stream starts TODAY 🏆
notes.notes:
We're celebrating the launch of Grapple Dog this weekend in style! 

Grapple Dog is perfect for however you play platformers - whether casually, as a completionist, etc - but we've loved seeing the speedrunning community take to it and we really wanted to give something back to a group of people whose work and content we've loved watching for years! 💛

That's why we've got a speedrun competition available for all to try, with a $3000 prize pool up for grabs! It's as easy as finishing World 1 faster than anyone else before the end of February and submitting your run to Speedrun.com... do you have what it takes? 

For full rules, T&Cs, submission details, and prize positions, just go here: bit.ly/GrappleDogComp 🏆

To kick things off, our friends at Global Speedrun Authority will be hosting their own, separate tournament over the weekend - with runners including EZScape, TheMexicanRunner, LilKirbs, iPK, Hendrizz, JJsrl, and Oshikorosu! 

You can catch this hotly-contested commentated event on Saturday 12th and Sunday 13th from 1pm ET/6pm GMT: twitch.tv/speedrun 🏃‍♀️

notes.title: Grapple Dog review: a cute yet frustrating platformer
notes.notes:
I resent Grapple Dog for making me resent Grapple Dog. Look at him. He doesn’t deserve it. See his little paws, there, dangling out of that cannon? Tip of the iceberg. You haven’t seen his eagerness, his joie de vivre, as he swings between the many improbably-convenient floating grapple hook platforms of the world. You haven’t witnessed the plucky determination with which he clambers up wall after wall, no matter how many times he’s climbed them before. You haven’t admired his gumption as he bounces atop each polar bear head, or upon the still bouncier belly of every (unwilling) crab.

By the end of my seven hours with Grapple Dog, I wanted to strangle the bastard with his own goddamn hook.

Hi all! 

[b]Grapple Dog [/b]is getting a ✨[i]completely free[/i]✨demo, especially for the Steam Next Fest event which lasts October 1st - October 7th! 

This demo includes multiple levels from throughout the final game, providing a great taster for the full release of the grapple-tastic action-platformer. 

To celebrate the occassion, developer [i]Joseph Gribbin[/i] has played through the new demo and shared some insights on its levels, mechanics, and development in this handy pre-recorded gameplay livestream! 

Also, wouldn't it be cool if demo players had the opportunity to have a statue in-game dedicated to them? That's exactly what's happening! Simply complete level 1-3's time trial mode in the fastest time possible and upload your full recording to Twitter, using #GrappleDog. The fastest run uploaded during Steam Next Fest will be honoured in the level. 

Some other prizes are available too... full details (and boring T&Cs) can be read here: https://pastebin.com/87cJTXdQ

Hi all! 

[b]Grapple Dog [/b]is getting a ✨[i]completely free[/i]✨demo, especially for the Steam Next Fest event which lasts October 1st - October 7th! 

This demo includes multiple levels from throughout the final game, providing a great taster for the full release of the grapple-tastic action-platformer. 

To celebrate the occassion, developer [i]Joseph Gribbin[/i] has played through the new demo and shared some insights on its levels, mechanics, and development in this handy pre-recorded gameplay livestream! 

Also, wouldn't it be cool if demo players had the opportunity to have a statue in-game dedicated to them? That's exactly what's happening! Simply complete level 1-3's time trial mode in the fastest time possible and upload your full recording to Twitter, using #GrappleDog. The fastest run uploaded during Steam Next Fest will be honoured in the level. 

Some other prizes are available too... full details (and boring T&Cs) can be read here: https://pastebin.com/87cJTXdQ

Don't forget to wishlist the game! It helps more than you could imagine. 💛
